"""L3 用: 削除前の Python 学習実装（ml/src/ml_train。sklearn lbfgs）から数値フィクスチャを生成する（1 回限り。Kotlin の許容差比較の正）。
生成物: ml-train/src/test/resources/python-reference/ml_reference_v1.json（生成元コミット・版・入力・本スクリプトの全文を含む）。"""
import hashlib, json, math, platform, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np, scipy, sklearn
REPO = Path(sys.argv[1]); OUT = Path(sys.argv[2])
sys.path[:0] = [str(REPO / "ml" / "src"), str(REPO)]
from ml_train import trainer, metrics as mx, gate as gate_mod, dataset as ds_mod, job, modeljson
from ml_train.config import TrainConfig, GateConfig
from tools.ml import canonical
import gzip

def fl(a): return [float(x) for x in np.asarray(a, dtype=np.float64).ravel()]

def objective(xs, y, w, coef, b, c):
    # sklearn の L2 ロジスティック回帰の目的関数（lbfgs）: C·Σ w_i·logloss_i + ½‖coef‖²（切片は罰則なし）
    z = xs @ coef + b
    ll = np.logaddexp(0, z) - y * z
    return float(c * np.sum((w if w is not None else 1.0) * ll) + 0.5 * coef @ coef)

def solver_case(name, n, d, seed, c, weighted, tol=1e-6, max_iter=500):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    x = rng.normal(size=(n, d)) * rng.uniform(0.5, 3.0, size=d) + rng.uniform(-2, 2, size=d)
    beta = rng.normal(size=d)
    pz = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-(x - x.mean(0)) / x.std(0) @ beta * 0.8 + 1.5))
    y = (rng.uniform(size=n) < pz).astype(np.int64)
    w = rng.uniform(0.2, 1.8, size=n) if weighted else np.ones(n)
    w = w / w.mean()
    model = trainer.train_linear(x, y, w, l2_c=c, max_iter=max_iter, tol=tol)
    xs = model.standardizer.apply(x)
    return {"name": name, "n": n, "d": d, "l2_c": c, "tol": tol, "max_iter": max_iter, "x": [fl(r) for r in x], "y": [int(v) for v in y], "w": fl(w),
            "mean": fl(model.standardizer.mean), "std": fl(model.standardizer.std), "weights": fl(model.weights), "bias": float(model.bias),
            "objective": objective(xs, y, w, model.weights, model.bias, c), "raw_probability": fl(model.raw_probability(x))}

def platt_case(name, seed, n):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    p = np.clip(rng.beta(1.2, 6.0, size=n), 1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
    y = (rng.uniform(size=n) < np.clip(p * 1.3, 0, 1)).astype(np.int64)
    a, b = trainer.fit_platt(p, y)
    return {"name": name, "p": fl(p), "y": [int(v) for v in y], "a": a, "b": b}

def metrics_case(name, seed, n, ties):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    p = rng.uniform(0.01, 0.6, size=n)
    if ties: p = np.round(p, 1)
    y = (rng.uniform(size=n) < p).astype(np.int64)
    races = np.array([f"R{i // 8:03d}" for i in range(n)])
    odds = np.round(1 / np.clip(p * rng.uniform(0.7, 1.1, size=n), 0.02, 0.9), 1)
    m, un = mx.evaluate(y, p, races, odds)
    return {"name": name, "p": fl(p), "y": [int(v) for v in y], "race_id": list(races), "odds": fl(odds), "metrics": modeljson.clean(m), "unavailable": un,
            "race_normalized": fl(mx.race_normalize(races, p)), "constant_feature_ratio_input": None}

def dataset_case(kind, cfg_json, gate_json):
    root = REPO / "domain/src/test/resources/ml/dataset"
    csv = (root / f"synthetic-{kind}.csv").read_bytes(); man = (root / f"synthetic-{kind}.manifest.json").read_bytes()
    ds = ds_mod.load(gzip.compress(csv, mtime=0), man, tenant_id=1, dataset_id=f"synthetic-{kind}")
    cfg = TrainConfig.from_json(cfg_json); gate = GateConfig.from_json(gate_json) if gate_json else GateConfig.unconfigured()
    tr = np.flatnonzero(ds.is_train); calib, ev = job._split_valid(ds, cfg.calibration_fraction)
    w = trainer.sample_weights(ds.race_date[tr], cfg.recency_halflife_days)
    base = trainer.train_linear(ds.X[tr], ds.y[tr], w, l2_c=cfg.l2_c, max_iter=cfg.max_iter, tol=cfg.tol)
    a, b = trainer.fit_platt(base.predict(ds.X[calib]), ds.y[calib]); model = base.with_platt(a, b)
    odds = ds.X[ev, ds.schema_names.index("odds")] if ds.has_odds else None
    m, un = mx.evaluate(ds.y[ev], model.predict(ds.X[ev]), ds.race_id[ev], odds)
    facts = {"metrics": m, "n_train": len(tr), "n_train_pos": int(ds.y[tr].sum()), "n_valid": int((~ds.is_train).sum()), "n_valid_pos": int(ds.y[~ds.is_train].sum()),
             "constant_feature_ratio": mx.constant_feature_ratio(ds.X[tr]), "horse_master_coverage": float(ds.manifest["quality"]["has_horse_master_ratio"]), "active_logloss": None}
    v = gate_mod.evaluate(gate, facts)
    xs = base.standardizer.apply(ds.X[tr])
    return {"kind": kind, "config": cfg.to_json(), "gate": gate.to_json() if gate.configured else None, "gate_digest": gate.digest(),
            "model_id": job.derive_model_id(1, ds.kind, ds.csv_sha256, cfg, gate),
            "train_idx": [int(i) for i in tr], "calib_idx": [int(i) for i in calib], "eval_idx": [int(i) for i in ev], "sample_weights": fl(w),
            "mean": fl(base.standardizer.mean), "std": fl(base.standardizer.std), "weights": fl(base.weights), "bias": float(base.bias),
            "objective": objective(xs, ds.y[tr], w, base.weights, base.bias, cfg.l2_c), "platt": [a, b],
            "eval_pred": fl(model.predict(ds.X[ev])), "eval_pred_uncalibrated": fl(base.predict(ds.X[ev])),
            "metrics": modeljson.clean(m), "unavailable": un, "constant_feature_ratio": facts["constant_feature_ratio"],
            "gate_result": v.to_json(), "status": "CANDIDATE" if v.passed else "REJECTED"}

commit = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
doc = {
  "fixture_schema_version": 1,
  "description": "削除前の Python 学習実装（ml/src/ml_train。scikit-learn LogisticRegression lbfgs）で生成した数値の正。Kotlin の :ml-train は同じ入力で許容差内に一致することを試験する（LANGUAGE_MIGRATION §4.2）。Kotlin の出力から期待値を作り直さない。",
  "generated_from_commit": commit, "generator": "このファイルの generator_source（実行した Python スクリプトの全文）",
  "runtime": {"python": platform.python_version(), "numpy": np.__version__, "scipy": scipy.__version__, "scikit-learn": sklearn.__version__, "machine": platform.machine()},
  "solver_cases": [solver_case("small-unweighted", 120, 4, 1, 1.0, False), solver_case("weighted-c0.5", 400, 6, 2, 0.5, True),
                   solver_case("weak-reg-c1000", 300, 5, 3, 1000.0, True), solver_case("strong-reg-c0.01", 300, 5, 4, 0.01, False)],
  "platt_cases": [platt_case("platt-500", 11, 500), platt_case("platt-80", 12, 80)],
  "metrics_cases": [metrics_case("metrics-no-ties", 21, 160, False), metrics_case("metrics-ties", 22, 160, True)],
  "dataset_cases": [dataset_case("calibration", {"kind": "calibration", "seed": 42, "l2_c": 1.0, "recency_halflife_days": 90}, {"purpose": "synthetic_test", "checks": {"min_valid_rows": 5, "max_valid_logloss": 5.0}}),
                    dataset_case("calibration", {"kind": "calibration", "seed": 7, "l2_c": 0.5}, {"purpose": "synthetic_test", "checks": {"max_valid_logloss": 0.0001}}),
                    dataset_case("calibration", {"kind": "calibration", "l2_c": 1.0, "recency_halflife_days": 240, "calibration_fraction": 0.3}, None),
                    dataset_case("alpha", {"kind": "alpha", "l2_c": 1.0, "recency_halflife_days": 180}, {"purpose": "synthetic_test", "checks": {"max_logloss_minus_market": 1.0, "min_valid_auc": 0.0}})],
  "generator_source": Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
}
OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(doc, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print("wrote", OUT, hashlib.sha256(OUT.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
